note: How scenes become video. 'builtin' draws each frame with Pillow and pipes it to FFmpeg. To plug in another renderer (Remotion, Hyperframes, Blender or anything that reads a scene file), add a line with a command list, never a shell string. Placeholders: {scene}, {out}, {width}, {height}, {fps}, {seconds}. Your own lines go in motion_renderers.json in the Proofhouse home folder.
